areas.description: Define areas/rooms for organizing entities in Home Assistant. Each area creates a sub-device linked to the main BoneIO device.

id.markdownDescription:
Area ID

Unique identifier for the area (used in output/input configurations).
Example: "living_room", "kitchen", "garage"
id.title: Id

name.markdownDescription:
Area Name

Display name for the area shown in Home Assistant.
Example: "Living Room", "Kitchen", "Garaż"
name.title: Name

areas.title: Areas
